stories.title: Power back on in Hawarden after early morning issues
stories.summary: Update, 06:45 18 Nov: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored. Earlier report: Part of Hawarden is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 9.26am. stories.title: North Wales councils asked for 5% to stand still. The draft budget guarantees 2.5%
stories.summary: Senior officers at Flintshire and five other North Wales councils told the Welsh Government they needed a funding rise of at least 5% just to keep services at their current level. stories.summary: Plans for a convenience store in Cefn-y-bedd to sell alcohol from 6am to 10pm, seven days a week, have drawn 11 objections from people living nearby. stories.title: New CPS rules let police charge shoplifters whatever the value of the goods or the plea
stories.summary: Police can now charge shoplifters themselves, whatever the value of the goods and whether or not the suspect admits it, under new rules in force from today. In Flintshire, recorded shoplifting rose by 16% in the year to March 2026, even as it fell across Wales and England, Office for National Statistics (ONS) figures show.

stories.title: Coffee King seeks suppliers for roasters and bakery ovens at Deeside Industrial Park site
stories.summary: The family-owned firm wants three industrial coffee roasters, packaging lines and bakery equipment, with bids due in by noon on Friday.
